visual_description: The image displays the official logo of NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration). The design features a stylized white bird in flight, set against a circular background divided into two shades of blue—darker blue at the top and lighter blue at the bottom. The acronym "NOAA" is written in bold white letters across the upper portion of the circle, overlaying the darker blue section. The overall layout is symmetrical and centered within the circular frame.
